Particles behind real text

Get started

This page holds every kind of motion the video tier must tell apart. The hero's particles are drawn on a canvas by a script that keeps running by itself, so the copy can only show a recording of them, behind the heading and the button, which stay real HTML.

The blob below is reshaped frame by frame by a script that rewrites its corner radii; no rule of CSS describes that, so it is recorded too. The badge is a Lottie animation, which the copy plays itself from its own JSON, and the orange strip moves with the scroll, which a recording could never follow.
